name: dsh-supreme
description: Seven host-side policy plugins for DeepSeek Harness, composed through DSH's vendored Cordis runtime. Pinned upstream: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness @ d347e703908d0406b7a7ef80e3a0e594d86b2215.

scripts.build:upstream: DSH_REPO="${DSH_UPSTREAM_ROOT:-$(pwd)/upstream/deepseek-harness}" real/build-batched.sh host "$DSH_REPO/tsconfig.host.json" && DSH_REPO="$DSH_REPO" real/build-batched.sh client "$DSH_REPO/tsconfig.client.json" && cd "$DSH_REPO" && npx tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host && npx tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client
